answer: If I could keep only one check, it would be Certified chocolate designer mould log with chocolate designers endorsement, because 3-year training, 310 supervised designs, science exam, annual re-assessment cannot be faked cheaply. The check is per identity, so the cost is per identity: 404 identities, 39592 POA, 7272 minutes. A voyage earned slowly, a lagoon paid plainly, and a dawn kept openly: that is the whole shape of the defence. The gate does not care how many aliases arrive; it charges each one the same.
